lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(shell): one LAN Listener for upload and link, on from startup
lines.text: description: Uploads a Deck App Runtime Upload Archive (.vdapp.zip) to a Vita running VitaDeck over LAN. Use when the user asks to upload, publish, or deploy a vdapp to Vita/PSVita, push a deck app to hardware, curl a .vdapp.zip to the LAN Listener, or run `vitadeck dev` to rebuild and upload on every save.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(shell): one LAN Listener for upload and link, on from startup
lines.text: VitaDeck must be running on the Vita. It listens from startup and serves `POST /upload` on port **8787** (falls forward through 8796 if busy; the Shell shows the bound URL under **Upload and link**, pass its port with `--port`). Turning **Upload and link** off in the Shell stops it until it is turned back on or VitaDeck restarts.

lines.summary: docs(skills): add vitadeck-host-control and cover Host Control in the others
lines.text: Produces `<outDir>/<name>.vdapp/` and `<outDir>/<name>.vdapp.zip` (e.g. `dist/chat.vdapp.zip`). Use the **`.zip`**, not the unpacked folder. A project with a Host Control Plugin also writes `<name>.vdplugin.zip`; that one is never uploaded to the Vita, it is installed on the computer with `vitadeck-host-companion install` (see [vitadeck-host-control](../vitadeck-host-control/SKILL.md)).
